text:
incident-bot: Pager: elevated 5xx rate detected on inference-gateway (eu-west) — spike from 00:12 to present. Alerts: 5xx > 10% of requests, gateway timeouts, model-runner OOM/segfaults :rotating_light:
oncall-jordan: On it. Jumping in — setting priority to P1. What customers impacted? :eyes:
sre-maria: Seeing a correlated surge of segfaults from model-runner pods (runner-quant-v2). Kernel traces show SIGSEGV at kv_cache.cpp:line 384. Rapid OOMs on encoder processes too. Attaching recent log snippet:
```
# tail -n 40 /var/log/runner/runner-quant-v2.log
[00:12:05] batch_id=1234 start seq_len=2048 mem=22G
[00:12:05] alloc failed: cannot allocate 4096MB
[00:12:06] ERROR: segfault at 0x0 (kv_cache.cpp:384) pid=2345
[00:12:06] core dumped
```
oncall-jordan: Thanks — starting runbook RR-23 (runtime crashes). @eng-runtime-lee can you confirm recent deploys to eu-west?
eng-runtime-lee: No infra deploys from runtime team in the last 2 hours. We did push a quant kernel change earlier to model-variant v2 (~+30m) via CI, but rollout was canary. Pulling canary metrics now. :mag:
sre-maria: Canary nodes show memory growth pattern: kvcache retention rising, GC not reclaiming. Could be KV cache regression combined with new quant kernel allocation behavior.
prod-nikhil: Noted customer impact on a few mid-market tenants — error rate ~18% for embeddings and chat endpoints. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/7623459999 (updating).
cust-success-olivia: Customer-reported: "Our app sees 502s for last 3 mins, heavy requeues." Flagging two enterprise customers on Dedicated — may need SLA outreach.
oncall-jordan: Immediate mitigation plan, stepwise:
1) Isolate the canary model-variant from serving pool (remove v2 from routing)
2) Scale up stable pool capacity to absorb traffic (add 6 runner instances)
3) Enable aggressive kvcache trim policy for affected pods
4) If OOMs continue, enable fallback to smaller model-variant v1 for heavy requests
Can someone run the routing change?
infra-ash: Running reroute: `redwoodctl traffic route remove --variant runner-quant-v2 --region eu-west` — running now.
```
$ redwoodctl traffic route remove --variant runner-quant-v2 --region eu-west
Removing variant runner-quant-v2 from router targets... success
```
eng-runtime-lee: Confirmed canary removed. Spawning 6 extra runner nodes (r4.large) to add capacity. KVCACHE trim enabled via env override on new pods: `KV_CACHE_TRIM=true;TRIM_INTERVAL=5s`. Patching rollout.
sre-maria: After removal, 5xx dropped from 18% -> 7% within 90s. Some residual timeouts (likely in-flight requests). Monitoring for new OOMs. :thumbsup:
cust-success-olivia: Noting initial customer acknowledgements — sending proactive note to impacted customers, mention mitigation and ETA for full restore ~30–45m.
prod-nikhil: Assigning postmortem owner: @eng-runtime-lee. Need RCA to cover quant kernel change + kvcache regression + rollout heuristics.
oncall-jordan: Can we capture cores and gdb traces for the segfaulted runner processes before we evict more pods? Need backtrace.
sre-maria: Cores saved to /mnt/cores/runner-2345.core. Attached minimal backtrace: `gdb /opt/runner/bin/runner /mnt/cores/runner-2345.core -ex 'bt full' -ex quit` shows kv_cache::get_chain()+0x4f. Sharing copy to secure bucket.
eng-runtime-lee: I'll take the core + patch a guarded allocation check to avoid null deref in kv_cache. Quick hotfix build started: runner-hotfix-7623. Rolling canary to 2 instances in eu-west.
infra-ash: Canary hotfix deployed: runner-hotfix-7623 -> 2 pods. Watching.
sre-maria: Hotfix pods stable, no OOMs so far on canary. 5xx at 3.2% and falling.
oncall-jordan: Good. Keep canary for 15m then roll to 100%. Meanwhile, customer impact page updated, post on-call summary to #incidents in 1h.
cust-success-olivia: ETA message drafted for impacted orgs — will send on confirm of full restore.
prod-nikhil: Action items captured: [isolate variant] done, [scale capacity] done, [collect cores/logs] done, [hotfix rollout] in progress, [postmortem assigned] done.
eng-runtime-lee: If hotfix holds, will prepare rollback/rollforward plan and PR with unit test covering kvcache edge-case.
sre-maria: Monitoring shows stable since 00:24 — 5xx under baseline. Closing active pager in 10m if no regressions. :white_check_mark:
oncall-jordan: Thanks team — keep updates if anything flips. After close, schedule follow-up with SRE+runtime+cust-success for customer comms and RCA timeline.
incident-bot: Pager resolved — incident status: mitigated (errors returned to baseline). Incident timeline: 00:12 trigger -> 00:26 mitigated. Link: https://incidents.redwood.ai/7623459999/summary :sparkles:
